effect: The packs are conditioned for temporary heat absorption, while active refrigeration is needed to restore their capacity.

expectation: I expect a field case equipped with cold packs to help keep the core frozen during transfers.

effect: The case is complete: active refrigeration maintains its temperature, while the frozen cartridges provide a short buffer during power changes.
reaction: The specific division of roles between the refrigerator and cartridges made the finished case satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the refrigerated field case was most worthwhile because its outdoor radiator explained how it can reject heat in Mars’s thin air.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the conditioned packs was a predictable final step, although it clarified how the case handles power changes.

surprise.text: I was interested that the cold packs only absorb heat for a limited time and need active refrigeration to restore their capacity.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each contributed to the case, though the last two combinations were the only available actions.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the second core reveals, though this chapter’s construction was mostly straightforward.
